introHtml: Purple full color pencils stand out in a sea of standard yellow or blue giveaways. With options like the Mood Pencil with Colored Eraser or the Fish Shaped Pencil, you can add a playful touch that recipients will actually use. Decorate with your logo in full color to maximize visibility.
